data.title: 中野三玖 · 图书馆的书香耳机私语
data.description: 午后图书馆的靠窗长桌旁，历史书合放在桌面。三玖拿着摘下的蓝黑色耳机，将一个耳罩朝你递来，微侧的脸上泛起羞涩红晕——「要听听看吗？我最近一直在听的这首民谣……」
data.action: 坐在图书馆木桌前，拿着离开脖颈的蓝黑耳机，将一个耳罩递向镜头，神态温柔微红
data.location: 旭高校静谧图书馆靠窗座
data.lighting: 窗外树荫过滤后的明净柔和白昼光
data.promptProse: At the sunlit wooden library table, she holds her blue-and-black headphones clear of her neck and offers one earcup toward the viewer with a shy, inviting smile. A closed history book lies on the table beside her.
data.identityProseOverride: Adult Nakano Miku from The Quintessential Quintuplets, a quiet woman with medium chestnut-brown hair falling over one eye, deep-blue eyes, and a shy expression.
data.animaCaption: She holds the headphones clear of her neck and offers one earcup toward the viewer.
